messages.subject: Trouble running example program from the installation
parts:

I installed R version 2.13.0, Hadoop version 0.20.1, and protobufs.

messages.author: 1ad746a6cf4f4c4e
messages.subject: Re: Trouble running example program from the installation
parts:
Ah, I figured it out.
Turns out there was also an older incompatible vesion of R (2.7.*) on
the cluster. I had to get rid of it so the Rhipe C engine could launch
the correct R version.
